meta.name: WealthSmith Animation Registry
meta.description: Approved WealthSmith MVP animation assets and usage metadata.

smith-ai-symbol-loop.description: Vector-based Smith AI / WealthSmith symbol loop used for suggestion-building and Smith AI insight generation states.

defaultCopy.title: Building Your Suggestions...
defaultCopy.description: We are checking your plan and wallet balance to find the best next actions.
defaultCopy.reassurance: No action will be taken automatically.

copyRules: Always pair the animation with clear loading copy.
Do not imply WealthSmith can move funds.
Do not imply Smith AI creates deterministic financial logic.

rules: Do not autoplay the loop when reduced motion is enabled.
Keep the same layout dimensions where possible to avoid layout shift.

accessibility.accessibleStatusText: Building your suggestions. No action will be taken automatically.
rules: Do not rely on motion alone.
Do not move focus to the animation.
Do not expose internal animation layers to screen readers.
Loading copy must be available to assistive technologies.
Test with the production Lottie renderer.
Verify file size before production release.

exampleUsage.title: Building Your Suggestions...
exampleUsage.description: We are checking your plan and wallet balance to find the best next actions.
exampleUsage.reassurance: No action will be taken automatically.

rules: Use only for Smith AI or suggestion-building states.
Do not use as a generic loader.
Do not store this file in assets/logo.
Parent state controls when the animation appears and disappears.
Suggestion Engine and deterministic rules produce the structured output; animation only communicates loading.

globalRules: Animation assets must be stored in assets/animations/.
Do not invent animation names or paths.
Do not use animation as the only loading signal.
Use static fallback when animation fails or reduced motion is enabled.
Do not use animations to imply guaranteed returns, custody, automatic execution, or investment certainty.
Do not use animation assets as replacement for logo assets.
